text:
jordan: Quick postmortem follow-up: last night's storage-cleanup flapped and caused a paging spike. We saw ~120 pages in ~10m with a lot of duplicates. Need concrete owners, dates, and minimal config changes to prevent recurrence.

maria: I dug into the alert stream 1:30-21:40 UTC. ~85% were duplicate failure alerts. Two root issues: aggressive retry backoff in the job + alert threshold too low. Also no dedupe upstream.

kevin: Proposed action list (I can take #1):
1) storage-cleanup alert threshold: bump from 3 -> 15 failures/10m. owner: kevin. due: 2025-01-12. Ticket: SINF-342.
2) add grouping in Alertmanager: group_by ['alertname','job'], group_interval 5m. owner: jordan. due: 2025-01-10.
3) scheduled job auto-silence: add silence window around cron. owner: sara. due: 2025-01-09.
4) ingestion-level dedupe: collapse identical alerts within 2m. owner: maria. due: 2025-01-11.
5) update runbook with remediation steps and escalation matrix. owner: nora. due: 2025-01-14.

sara: I can implement the silence automation. Confirming cron for cleanup job is `0 3 * * *` (UTC?) so I'll set window +/-2m. Anyone object?

maria: That's the cron. Also advocating a small retry backoff fix in the cleanup job to avoid bursts; we should add that to the job PR.

jordan: Example Alertmanager snippet I want applied:```
group_by: ['alertname', 'job']
group_wait: 30s
group_interval: 5m
repeat_interval: 1h
```

maria: +1. For dedupe we should keep a count in the collapsed message (so humans see total volume) rather than dropping alerts entirely.

kevin: I'll open the threshold PR against ops-alerts and include a mini-experiment showing false positive drop. Will tag reviewers @jordan @maria.

ops-bot: Created ticket SINF-342 - "storage-cleanup noisy pages" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-342

nora: I'll update the runbook with step-by-step commands, escalation contacts, and a short checklist to silence and verify. Will link to the ticket when done.

jordan: Decision check: collapse + count for duplicates. Agreed?

maria: Agreed. We'll collapse on identical fingerprint and include a count and list of unique instance IDs.

sara: I'll send a small ops-config PR to add the cron silence rule (2m before/after) and a note in the scheduled jobs doc.

kevin: timeline OK for me. Will create SINF-342 subtask for the benchmark.

nora: Will target runbook update by due date.

jordan: I'll schedule a short 15m sync on Wed 10:00am PST to review PRs and move tickets to in-progress. If anyone needs reassignment or different deadlines, speak up here.

maria: I'll add a dashboard panel tracking duplicate-rate and paging count for the next 7 days so we can observe impact.

jordan: Thanks all 1: marking this resolved in the postmortem follow-up doc and moving items into the ticket backlog.
